pages.title: Dorami Smiling with Her Large Head Bow, Bell Collar, and Checked Four-dimensional Pocket Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami smiles and raises one hand in this printable coloring page, displaying her large head bow, bell collar, and checked four-dimensional pocket against a plain background. Her flower-shaped tail and rounded feet complete the coloring sheet, with broad open areas around the smaller diamond pattern on her pocket.

pages.title: Dorami Hugging Doraemon Outside Nobita's House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami hugging Doraemon outside Nobita's house, with both characters smiling beneath the home's wide upper window and sloping roof. Their round bodies fill the foreground of the coloring sheet, while the fence, doorway, and shrubs add smaller background sections.

pages.title: Dorami Holding Her Favorite Melon Bread Bun Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami holds her favorite melon bread bun in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath her oversized bow with bushes and scattered grass behind her. The bun's crisscross pattern echoes her checked pocket, giving this coloring sheet small enclosed sections alongside the broad outlines of her face and body.

pages.title: Dorami Encouraging Crow the Scarecrow Robot in His Straw Hat Outside the Robot Princess Aurora's Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami encouraging Crow the scarecrow robot outside Princess Aurora's castle, with his wide straw hat and patched outfit clearly visible. Dorami reaches toward his arm in the coloring sheet, while twin towers, flags, and an arched entrance frame the pair.

pages.title: Dorami Flying with a Take-copter Above the Town Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami flies above the town with a Take-copter in this printable coloring page, spreading her arms beneath the small propeller attached above her bow. Her large rounded figure dominates the coloring sheet, with rows of rooftops, leafy trees, distant hills, and small clouds arranged below and around her.

pages.title: Dorami Piloting Her Tulip-shaped Time Machine Through a Time Tunnel Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Dorami piloting her tulip-shaped time machine through a curling time tunnel, with both hands resting on the upright controls. Overlapping petal panels form the vehicle on the coloring sheet, while sweeping curved bands and narrow streaks surround its open cockpit.

pages.title: Dorami Backing Away From a Cockroach on the Kitchen Floor Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami backs away from a cockroach on the kitchen floor in this printable coloring page, holding up both hands with a startled, open-mouthed expression. The insect's antennae and legs form tiny details on the coloring sheet, contrasting with the wide floor tiles, cupboard doors, and sink behind Dorami.

pages.title: Dorami Walking with Sewashi Through the Twenty-second-century City Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami walking with Sewashi through a twenty-second-century city, beneath rounded towers, an elevated walkway, and a small flying vehicle. Sewashi's belted outfit and Dorami's checked pocket provide patterned accents on the coloring sheet, while the curving path keeps both figures prominent.

pages.title: Dorami Buying Melon Bread at a Bakery Counter Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami buys melon bread at a bakery counter in this printable coloring page, holding up a coin as the shopkeeper offers a bun on a plate. Trays of patterned rolls, shelves of loaves, and hanging lamps fill the coloring sheet with distinct sections around the two smiling figures.

pages.title: Dorami Celebrating Her Birthday with Doraemon, Nobita, and Shizuka Around a Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami celebrating her birthday with Doraemon and Shizuka around a cake decorated with strawberries, beneath balloons and triangular bunting. Dorami wears a striped party hat, Doraemon holds a ribboned gift, and Shizuka claps beside the round table. Small strawberry seeds and cake layers add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dorami Placing the Wallpaper House Entrance on the Vacant-lot Wall Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami placing the Wallpaper House entrance on a vacant-lot wall, holding the curling lower edge beneath a flower-decorated arch. Her large bow and checked pocket stand beside the rectangular brickwork on the coloring sheet, with small grass tufts along the wall's base.

pages.title: Dorami Hosting a Birthday Quiz for Nobita and Suneo in Her Futuristic Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami hosts a birthday quiz for Nobita and Suneo in this printable coloring page, displaying a question-mark card from a raised platform in her futuristic room. Each boy stands at a rounded buzzer pedestal on the coloring sheet, with a candle-topped cake, balloons, and a circular window behind them.

pages.title: Dorami Sitting with Nobita and Shizuka at a Cherry Blossom Picnic Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami sits between Nobita and Shizuka at a cherry blossom picnic in this printable coloring page, with a food box and handled basket before them. An overhanging branch and scattered petals frame the three seated figures on the coloring sheet, while the basket weave adds fine detail near the blanket.

pages.title: Dorami Receiving Homemade Melon Bread From Nobita Beneath the Cherry Blossoms Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami receiving homemade melon bread from Nobita beneath cherry blossoms, with both characters holding the tray between their outstretched hands. The large patterned bun centers the coloring sheet, while falling petals, grass tufts, and the flowered branch leave open space around the smiling pair.

pages.title: Dorami Opening the Anywhere Door Onto a Frozen Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami opens the Anywhere Door onto a frozen lake in this printable coloring page, revealing snowy banks and distant fir trees through the tall doorway. Her hand rests by the knob on the coloring sheet, contrasting the room's straight floorboards with the irregular ice lines and snow outside.

pages.title: Dorami Using the Small Light to Shrink Nobita for Skating on a Frozen Washbasin Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami using the Small Light to shrink Nobita for skating on a frozen washbasin, aiming its beam toward his miniature figure. The large round basin anchors the coloring sheet, with fine skate laces and blades set against Dorami's broad face, bow, and checked pocket.

pages.title: Dorami Coaching Nobita as He Practices Skating Indoors with Slippery Gas Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami coaches Nobita as he practices skating indoors with Slippery Gas in this printable coloring page, holding a spray can beside his laced ice skates. His crossing legs suggest movement across the floorboards on the coloring sheet, with a curtained window, desk, and chair completing the room.

pages.title: Dorami Demonstrating the Weight-changing Meter to Nobita's Mother in the Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami demonstrating the Weight-changing Meter to Nobita's mother in the kitchen, holding its labeled dial where she can see it. Her mother's glasses and tied apron add small details to the coloring sheet, while cupboards, a stove, and a sink establish the room around them.

pages.title: Dorami Giving Nobita a Bottle of Invisible-person Eyedrops in His Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami gives Nobita a bottle of Invisible-person Eyedrops in this printable coloring page, passing the small eye-labeled container between their hands in his bedroom. The coloring sheet includes his round glasses, her large bow, and a desk with upright books, while the bed and window remain simply outlined behind them.

pages.title: Dorami Using the Come-come Cat Gadget to Invite Shizuka to Nobita's House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami using the Come-come Cat gadget to invite Shizuka to Nobita's house, holding the waving cat beside the open entrance. Shizuka steps toward the doorway on the coloring sheet, with her pleated skirt, paired ponytails, and shoes adding smaller sections around Dorami's rounded silhouette.

pages.title: Dorami Offering Nobita Urashima Candy in His Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami offers Nobita Urashima Candy in this printable coloring page, opening a small round container as he reaches toward it from behind a low table. Spiral candy, Nobita's glasses, and the container lid provide fine details on the coloring sheet, with a desk, lamp, and bed in the background.

pages.title: Dorami Looking Surprised as Unwanted Objects Tumble Out of Her Malfunctioning Pocket Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami looking surprised as unwanted objects tumble from her malfunctioning pocket, with a shoe, spoon, and crumpled paper beside her. Her open mouth and raised hands emphasize the reaction on the coloring sheet, while the plain background leaves her large bow and pocket pattern unobstructed.

pages.title: Dorami and Nobita Watching Shizuka's Pet Bird Pi-chan Escape From Its Cage Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami and Nobita watch Shizuka's pet bird Pi-chan escape its cage in this printable coloring page, looking upward as its wings spread above the table. The open cage door, curved bars, and tiny bird claws provide detailed sections on the coloring sheet, while a potted flower sits by the curtained window.

pages.title: Dorami Checking on a Sleeping Doraemon Before His Robot Medical Inspection Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami checking on a sleeping Doraemon before his robot medical inspection, standing beside his pillow with a handled case nearby. His closed eyes, folded hands, and draped blanket create rounded shapes across the coloring sheet, while a lamp and books sit on the background drawers.

pages.title: Dorami Giving Nobita a Santa Mail Postcard Beside a Mailbox Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami gives Nobita a Santa Mail postcard beside a mailbox in this printable coloring page, with a smiling Santa face pictured on the small card. Nobita wears a coat and fringed scarf on the coloring sheet, while outlined snowflakes and a bare, snow-covered tree frame their exchange.

pages.title: Dorami Dressed as the Little Match Girl Selling Matches on a Snowy Christmas Street Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami dressed as the Little Match Girl selling matches on a snowy Christmas street, holding one match beside an open box. Her ruffled hood and fringed shawl create detailed borders on the coloring sheet, with a wreath-decorated window, streetlamp, and snowy paving behind her.

pages.title: Dorami and Nobita Searching for Rumi While Carrying Her Lost Doll on Christmas Eve Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami and Nobita search for Rumi on Christmas Eve in this printable coloring page, walking through a snowy street as Nobita carries her lost doll. The doll's dress and ponytails add small details to the coloring sheet, while a wreath, streetlamp, and snow-covered tree establish their winter surroundings.

pages.title: Dorami and Doraemon Shrinking Down to Rescue Nobita Inside a Giant Christmas Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami and Doraemon shrinking down to rescue Nobita inside a giant Christmas cake, with Dorami raising a light toward him. Tall sponge layers, strawberry slices, and piped cream surround the miniature characters on the coloring sheet, beneath holly and a star-topped tree decoration.

pages.title: Dorami Launching Nobita From the Bottle-shaped Cork Rocket Toward Suneo's House Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami launches Nobita from a bottle-shaped Cork Rocket toward Suneo's house in this printable coloring page, watching him wave while riding the large flying cork. The mounted bottle and diagonal motion lines organize the coloring sheet, with the house, its gate, and shrubs grouped beneath Nobita's raised feet.

pages.title: Dorami Dressed as a Witch Climbing Princess Shizuka's Long Braid Toward a Tower Window Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami dressed as a witch climbing Princess Shizuka's long braid toward a tower window, wearing a pointed hat and short cape. Shizuka leans over the sill in a crown and puff-sleeved dress on the coloring sheet, while broad stone blocks surround the twisting braid.

pages.title: Dorami Pinning the Momotaro Story Badge Onto Nobita's Shirt Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami pins the Momotaro Story Badge onto Nobita's shirt in this printable coloring page, positioning the round peach-emblem badge beside his chest pocket as he smiles. Their hands and the badge form the central details on the coloring sheet, surrounded by broad clothing shapes and simply drawn room panels.

pages.title: Dorami and Nobita Giving a Dog Kibi Dango During Their Momotaro Adventure Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami and Nobita giving a dog Kibi Dango during their Momotaro adventure, kneeling on either side with round treats extended. The dog's floppy ears, raised tail, and open mouth center the coloring sheet, while a winding path, mountains, and a large peach appear behind them.

pages.title: Dorami Showing Nobita the Tsuchinoko Entry in a Twenty-second-century Encyclopedia Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami shows Nobita the Tsuchinoko entry in a twenty-second-century encyclopedia in this printable coloring page, holding an open electronic book beneath their smiling faces. The spotted creature illustration, small buttons, and round control add fine sections to the coloring sheet, while the plain background keeps attention on the pair.

pages.title: Dorami and Nobita Searching for a Tsuchinoko in the Woods During Their Time-travel Adventure Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Dorami and Nobita searching for a Tsuchinoko in the woods during their time-travel adventure, both holding magnifying glasses near the creature. A wheeled device with an antenna stands between them on the coloring sheet, with tall tree trunks and rounded shrubs enclosing the scene.

pages.title: Dorami Attending a Medieval Castle Ball with Doraemon and Nobita Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami attends a medieval castle ball with Doraemon and Nobita in this printable coloring page, wearing a layered dress as the trio hold hands beneath a chandelier. Nobita's cape and belted tunic, Doraemon's formal jacket, and the tall arched windows create distinct costume and architectural sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dorami Meeting Prince Georges Beside His Medieval Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami meeting Prince Georges beside his medieval castle, raising one hand as the crowned prince extends his palm toward her. Nobita stands behind Dorami on the coloring sheet, while the prince's long cape, large belt buckle, and the castle's arched gate provide additional outlined details.

pages.title: Dorami Facing Armored Soldiers with Doraemon and Nobita at a Medieval Castle Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami faces armored soldiers with Doraemon and Nobita at a medieval castle gate in this printable coloring page, standing opposite two guards holding tall spears. Their worried expressions contrast with the soldiers' rigid poses on the coloring sheet, while riveted wooden doors, round towers, and battlements fill the background.

pages.title: Dorami and Sewashi Escaping From Vampire Robots in the Future City Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami and Sewashi escaping vampire robots in the future city, running ahead of two fanged pursuers with raised hands. High collars, spreading capes, and mechanical joints distinguish the robots on the coloring sheet, while rounded towers and an elevated roadway curve around the chase.

pages.title: Dorami Transformed Into Vampire Doramyula Chasing Doraemon Through Nobita's Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami transforms into vampire Doramyula and chases Doraemon through Nobita's room in this printable coloring page, showing pointed fangs as Doraemon runs past a low table. Their raised arms and motion marks animate the coloring sheet, with bookshelves, a curtained window, and a floor cushion adding room details.

pages.title: Dorami as Vampire Doramyula Leading Robot Mice Through Dracula's Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami as vampire Doramyula leading robot mice through Dracula's castle, wearing a high-collared cape and displaying two pointed fangs. Three mice with jointed legs, round ears, and segmented tails follow across the coloring sheet, surrounded by stone columns, floor tiles, and an arched doorway.

pages.title: Dorami Helping Nobita Send Shizuka's Brooch with a Mini Hot Air Balloon Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami helps Nobita send Shizuka's brooch with a mini hot air balloon in this printable coloring page, standing beside its basket as Nobita supports it. The oval jeweled brooch, basket weave, and suspension ropes provide small details on the coloring sheet, beneath the balloon's broad panels and scalloped trim.

pages.title: Dorami and Sewashi Watching a News Report Showing Doraemon as a Wanted Robot Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami and Sewashi watching a news report presenting Doraemon as a wanted robot, seated together before a large television screen. A newsreader, Doraemon portrait, and star-bearing shield appear on the coloring sheet's screen, while a potted plant and low table complete the living room.

pages.title: Dorami Emerging From Nobita's Desk Drawer with a Giant Dorayaki for Doraemon Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami emerges from Nobita's desk drawer with a giant dorayaki for Doraemon in this printable coloring page, holding the round treat as he reaches upward. The open drawer and desk legs create straight-edged sections on the coloring sheet, contrasting with the characters' round faces, bells, and wide smiling mouths.

pages.title: Dorami Lending Doraemon the Movie Can Gadgets for His Birthday Adventure Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami lending Doraemon the Movie Can gadgets for his birthday adventure, passing a dinosaur-decorated can between their hands beside a table. Two more cans display a ringed planet and castle on the coloring sheet, while a candle-topped cake appears behind the smiling pair.

pages.title: Dorami and Shizuka Helping Captain Kenneth Aboard a Caribbean Pirate Ship Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami and Shizuka help Captain Kenneth aboard a Caribbean pirate ship in this printable coloring page, with Dorami holding rope while Shizuka carries an open compass. The captain grips the large wheel on the coloring sheet, surrounded by deck planks, rigging, a mast, and a broad sail above the sea.

pages.title: Dorami Cradling a Maiasaura Egg in a Prehistoric Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami cradling a Maiasaura egg in a prehistoric clearing, holding its broad oval shape between both hands beneath her smiling face. Fern fronds, a tall palm-like tree, and scattered rocks surround her on the coloring sheet, adding fine leaf details around the open egg and body.

pages.title: Dorami and Sewashi Greeting Maisuke the Newly Hatched Baby Maiasaura Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami and Sewashi greet Maisuke, the newly hatched baby Maiasaura, in this printable coloring page, raising their hands beside the dinosaur and its broken shell. Jagged eggshell pieces, back markings, and rounded toes add distinct small sections to the coloring sheet, with ferns and rocks framing the three figures.

pages.title: Dorami Using a Remote Hologram to Protect Maisuke From a Tyrannosaurus Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami using a remote hologram to protect Maisuke from a Tyrannosaurus, projecting a dashed dinosaur outline between them and the predator. The Tyrannosaurus's open jaws contrast with the smaller baby on the coloring sheet, while rocky slopes, palms, and foliage surround Dorami's raised device.

pages.title: Dorami Finding Nobisuke, Nobita's Young Son, and the Mini-doras During Their Future-world Adventure Coloring Page
pages.description: Dorami finds Nobisuke, Nobita's young son, and the Mini-doras during their future-world adventure in this printable coloring page, gathering with them on a futuristic street. Three small Mini-doras smile around the boy's feet on the coloring sheet, beneath rounded towers, an elevated walkway, and a curved streetlamp.

pages.title: Dorami Giving Nobihira a Pair of Glasses at the Children's Mountain-bandit Camp Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dorami giving Nobihira a pair of glasses at the children's mountain-bandit camp, holding the round frames toward his waiting hands. Nobihira's tied robe and rope sandals add clothing details to the coloring sheet, with a pole-supported shelter, trees, and distant mountain outlines behind them.

pages.title: Doraemon Dorami Exploring in Robot School Coloring Page
pages.description: Doraemon and Dorami explore Robot School in this printable coloring page, walking past worktables with small robots, loose gears, and tools beneath exposed overhead pipes. A lesson board, labeled lab door, and computer consoles add many enclosed details to the coloring sheet, while the smiling pair remain central.

pages.title: Doraemon Dorami Posing in Nobita's Bedroom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Doraemon and Dorami posing in Nobita's bedroom, with Doraemon holding a partly eaten snack while Dorami raises one hand. Her flower-patterned bow and pocketed dress add smaller sections to the coloring sheet, surrounded by floorboards, a bookshelf, and a desk below the curtained window.

pages.title: Doraemon Dorami Walking on Back Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: Doraemon and Dorami walk on Back Hill in this printable coloring page, lifting their feet along a winding path beneath outlined clouds and a partial sun. Dorami's flower-shaped tail and both bell collars remain clear on the coloring sheet, while rolling hills and a leafy tree provide broad background areas.

pages.title: Doraemon Dorami Walking in Treasure Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Doraemon and Dorami walking on Treasure Island, smiling along a marked path with palm trees and a treasure chest behind them. Scattered coins, small rocks, and Dorami's spotted bow add details to the coloring sheet, while a distant sailing ship sits beyond the beach.

pages.title: Doraemon Dorami Waving on Back Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: Doraemon and Dorami wave on Back Hill in this printable coloring page, standing together on the grassy summit with broad smiles beneath large cloud outlines. Dorami's flower-patterned pocket and small flower tail add detail to the coloring sheet, while the distant hills and open sky use wide, uncluttered shapes.

pages.title: Doraemon Dorami Looking Around in Desert Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Doraemon and Dorami looking around a desert kingdom, with Doraemon raising both hands beside Dorami's large bow and checked pocket. A domed palace, tower, palm trees, and distant rocky cliffs fill the coloring sheet's background, with rolling dunes and small cacti around the pair.

pages.title: Doraemon Dorami Posing on Alien Planet Coloring Page
pages.description: Doraemon and Dorami pose on an alien planet in this printable coloring page, with Dorami making a two-finger gesture beside Doraemon's raised round hand. Craters, pointed rocks, and unusual plants surround them on the coloring sheet, under a crescent moon, scattered stars, and a ringed planet.

pages.title: Doraemon Dorami Running in Gadget Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Doraemon and Dorami running through a gadget workshop, smiling with raised feet as shelves of tools and devices fill the room. A large light bulb, hanging wrench, wall clock, and open doorway add distinct details to the coloring sheet around the two central figures.

pages.title: Doraemon Dorami Posing in Magical Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Doraemon and Dorami pose in a magical forest in this printable coloring page, holding hands and raising their free arms beside oversized trees and mushrooms. A sparkling arched doorway appears behind them on the coloring sheet, with curling flower stems, broad leaves, and scattered stones framing their smiling faces.

pages.title: Doraemon Dorami Looking Around in Ancient Japan Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Doraemon and Dorami looking around Ancient Japan, standing along a stream near traditional houses, hanging lanterns, and a curved wooden bridge. The distant mountain and tiered structure add depth to the coloring sheet, while window grids and roof tiles provide smaller sections behind the pair.

pages.title: Doraemon Dorami Sitting in Gadget Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: Doraemon and Dorami sit in a gadget workshop in this printable coloring page, raising their hands from round stools in front of a tool-covered workbench. Dorami's striped bow and diagonal pocket pattern add accents to the coloring sheet, with hanging wrenches, gears, jars, and an open cupboard behind them.
